_note: LONG-CONTEXT CHUNKED PREFILL campaign (user 2026-09-27: chunked prefill, 16k/32k per chunk, contexts >= 128k up to 262k, for both MLA and KDA on the SAME shapes). AGENT = Claude Code (Opus 5.5 via Bedrock). ONE MLA decoder layer of Kimi-K3 on sglang v0.5.20, B200, cookbook production shape (12 heads/rank, trtllm_mla prefill backend: MHA_CHUNKED_KV = TRT-LLM ragged fp8 attention over the chunk + chunked prefix-KV attention merged with merge_state, fp8_e4m3 latent KV written per token, EP8 rank = 112 mxfp4 experts). Points are prefill chunks (EXTEND) `B,L,pf<prefix>`: 1 request x L NEW tokens on a <prefix>-token cached context. Primary: the 16,384-token chunk that completes a 262,144-token prompt (prefix 245,760 cached fp8 latent-KV tokens attended through the chunked-prefix path); secondaries: a 32,768-token chunk completing 262,144 (prefix 229,376), and 16k / 32k chunks at a 131,072-token prefix. Metric = eager step time. Correctness = output + written fp8 KV rows vs a seeded golden from the pristine tree, row-wise prefill rule. Production-fidelity driver flags --bf16-gemm-init --flashinfer-autotune. GPU mode: slurm (K3_GPU_MODE=slurm).
